text:
devops-bot: ALERT — NAT gateway SNAT ports near capacity in us-west-2a (CloudWatch alarm triggered)
Sam: seeing intermittent 502s from model-hosted routes since ~10:12 UTC
Priya: yep I'm getting reports of failing model pulls and connection_reset errors
Michaela: logs from sidecars show lots of TIME_WAIT and "connect: no route to host" ... pasting snippet:
``` 
[2026-03-09T10:11:58Z] model-fetcher ERROR connect to 52.95.123.10:443: connection reset by peer
[2026-03-09T10:12:05Z] http: dial tcp 10.0.0.12:443: socket: cannot assign requested address
``` 
Leo: can you run conntrack and netstat on an affected node? think SNAT ports are exhausted
Michaela: ran on node-cc-12:
```bash
$ sudo conntrack -L | wc -l
98023
$ ss -s | head -n 5
TCP: 98023 (estab 1200, closed 95000, orphan 0, timewait 94000)
$ netstat -anp | grep TIME_WAIT | wc -l
94000
```
Priya: that matches SNAT exhaustion (lots of TIME_WAIT). NAT Gateway only has about 64k ephemeral ports per Elastic IP per destination tuple
Sam: which services are causing high egress? model pulls, telemetry, and image downloads
Michaela: big culprits: ECR pulls and our telemetry batch uploads (lots of short-lived connections)
Leo: temporary fix: add another NAT Gateway and update route table to spread AZs. Also lower AZ affinity for ASG so instances use other NAT
Priya: agreed. Also immediate improvement: enable VPC endpoints for S3 and ECR, and add HTTP connection pooling in the upload client
Sam: can we do fast rollback if costs spike? schedule autoscaling to avoid cross-AZ NAT imbalance
Michaela: doing NAT GW create now in us-west-2b (allocating EIP). Will update route table in 2 AZs.
Priya: I'll open a short runbook with mitigations and add instrumentation to alert on conntrack > 50k per node
Leo: follow-ups: 1) add S3/ECR endpoints 2) implement keepalive + connection reuse in fetcher 3) long-term: egress proxy with connection pooling or dedicated NAT instances for high-volume jobs
Sam: reminder: add cost estimate for extra NAT GW + EIPs in the ticket
devops-bot: ACTION CREATED — infra/egress-nat-mitigation-181800 (assignee: Priya) :thumbsup:
Priya: I'll post a postmortem template after we stabilize
Sam: thanks everyone — ping me if any rollback needed
